blockers.description: Official v5.3 document and example bodies and per-file content hashes are not retained.
Generated documentation has not been reproduced from the exact release.
Potential/model files, datasets, trained weights, and executable examples require independent byte identities and provenance records.
Exact binary, backend, GPU runtime, build flags, and native execution behavior are not validated by this pack.

gpumd-exact-document-tree-inventory.title: GPUMD v5.3 complete doc and examples tree metadata inventory

limitations: The exact source-tree inventory does not establish a native GPU build, binary behavior, selected model/data identities, NEP transferability, transport convergence, or scientific acceptance.

External raw identity is the SHA-256 of canonical sorted git ls-tree -r receipt lines '<mode> <object_type> <object_id>\t<path>\n' for every inventory entry; the local inventory JSON is metadata evidence only and contains no official document body bytes.
The inventory identity binds the exact pre-migration catalog bytes as migration metadata; it does not identify any upstream document body.

document-bodies-not-retained.description: Only exact Git path and object metadata are retained; documentation and example bodies remain external.

executable-examples-and-models-external.description: Executable example inputs, datasets, potential/model files, trained weights, and outputs are retained only as path/object metadata and are never executed or deserialized.

native-gpu-runtime-unverified.description: GPU backend, build flags, hardware/runtime compatibility, binary identity, and native behavior are not established by source documentation.

rendered-build-not-replayed.description: The exact v5.3 documentation build and generated navigation/reference surfaces have not been reproduced.

examples.release-workflows.statement: The exact v5.3 examples tree is supporting official workflow material whose executable inputs, data, models, and outputs require separate review.
